                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ଏହାର ଖୋଲା ବଜାର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଯୁକ୍ତରାଷ୍ଟ୍ରର ଫେଡେରାଲ ରିଜର୍ଭ ରେପୋ ଏବଂ ଓଲଟା ରେପୋ କାରବାର କରେ |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କିଙ୍ଗ୍ ସେକ୍ଟର ସଂସ୍କାର ଉପରେ ନରସିଂହମ କମିଟି (1998) ଫଳସ୍ୱରୂପ RBI LAF କୁ ପ୍ରବର୍ତ୍ତନ କଲା |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ରିଜର୍ଭ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଅଫ୍ ଇଣ୍ଡିଆ (RBI) ହେଉଛି ଭାରତର କେନ୍ଦ୍ରୀୟ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ରିଜର୍ଭ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଅଫ୍ ଇଣ୍ଡିଆ ଆକ୍ଟ, 1934 ର ସର୍ତ୍ତାବଳୀ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଏହା କଲିକତାରେ ଏପ୍ରିଲ୍ 1, 1935 ରେ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରାଯାଇଥିଲା |\n\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ଏହା ସ୍ଥାୟୀ ଭାବରେ 1937 ରେ ମୁମ୍ବାଇକୁ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ମୂଳତଃ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ମାଲିକାନା ଥିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ 1949 ରେ ଜାତୀୟକରଣ ପରଠାରୁ ରିଜର୍ଭ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାବେ ଭାରତ ସରକାରଙ୍କ ମାଲିକାନାରେ ଅଛି |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ମୁଦ୍ରା ନୀତିର ଏକ ଗୁଣାତ୍ମକ ଉପକରଣ ଭାବରେ, ରିଜର୍ଭ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଅଫ୍ ଇଣ୍ଡିଆ (RBI) ନୈତିକ ପ୍ରବର୍ତ୍ତନ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଏହା ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ନୋଟ୍ ଜାରି କରିବା ଏବଂ ସଂରକ୍ଷଣ ରଖିବାକୁ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ କରେ ଯାହା ଦ୍ୱାରା ଭାରତରେ ମୁଦ୍ରା ସ୍ଥିରତା ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ ରହିବ ଏବଂ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ଦେଶର ମୁଦ୍ରା ଏବଂ କ୍ରେଡିଟ୍ ସିଷ୍ଟମକୁ ଏହାର ସୁବିଧା ପାଇଁ ପରିଚାଳନା କରିବ |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଏହା ଏହାର ମୁଦ୍ରା ନୀତି କମିଟି (MPC) ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ମୁଦ୍ରା ନୀତିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ତଦାରଖ କରେ |
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n218:Tc00,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is "Steady."

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The word "Topple" means to become less steady and fall down. (अस्थिर होकर लुढ़क जाना)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: Don’t add another book to the pile or it will topple over.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The most appropriate antonym of "topple" is "steady."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The word "Steady" means to stop yourself/somebody/something from moving, shaking or falling; to stop moving, shaking or falling. (किसी को स्थिर करना (किसी को हिलने, काँपने या गिरने न देना); स्थिर होना (न हिलना, काँपना या गिरना))\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: He had to steady his nerves/voice before beginning his speech.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The correct answer is Option 3.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Plunge: to jump, drop or fall suddenly and with force. (अचानक ज़ोरों से छलाँग लगाना, गिरना या गिर जाना, डुबकी लगाना)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Fumble: to try to find or take hold of something with your hands in a nervous or careless way. (परेशानी की हालत में या लापरवाही से कुछ ढूँढ़ने या पकड़ने की कोशिश करना; टटोलना)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Tumble: to fall down suddenly but without serious injury. ((लड़खड़ाकर) एकाएक गिर पड़ना (बिना अधिक चोट खाए))
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n219:Tdbf,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is "Kiosk."

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \nKey Points \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A kiosk is a small, standalone structure or booth typically located in public places, such as malls, airports, or outdoor areas. (सड़क पर बनी बहुत छोटी दुकान जहाँ अख़बार, मिठाइयाँ आदि बिकती है; गुमटी, स्‍टॉल)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • It is designed to provide information, services, or products to people in a self-service manner.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The term "kiosk" can also refer to a small open-fronted hut or pavilion, especially one in a public space for the sale of newspapers, refreshments, or other goods.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • So, a small structure with one or more open sides that is used to vend merchandise is called "Kiosk."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The correct answer is Option 4.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \nDirection: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Partial or total loss of memory

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Ascetic"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Amnesia"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Atheist"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Axiom"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is "Amnesia."

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \nKey Points \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • "Amnesia" refers to a condition characterized by the partial or complete loss of memory. (याद्‌दाश्‍त खो बैठने की अवस्‍था; स्‍मृति-लोप)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • This loss of memory can be temporary or permanent and may affect various aspects of a person's life, including their personal experiences, identity, and knowledge.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • So, a partial or total loss of memory is called "Amnesia."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The correct answer is Option 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Ascetic: not allowing yourself physical pleasures, especially for religious reasons. (विशेषतः धार्मिक कारणों से भौतिक सुखों से विमुख)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Atheist: a person who disbelieves or lacks belief in the existence of God or gods. (नास्तिक, निरीश्‍वरवादी)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Axiom: a rule or principle that most people believe to be true.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     \nKey Points \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The words "anger" and "irritate" both describe actions that cause negative emotions, but they differ in intensity and duration. (शब्द "Anger" और "Irritate" दोनों उन कार्यों का वर्णन करते हैं जो नकारात्मक भावनाओं का कारण बनते हैं, लेकिन वे तीव्रता और अवधि में भिन्न होते हैं।)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • "Anger" is a strong emotion involving a sense of displeasure or hostility. (एक प्रबल भावना जिसमें अप्रसन्नता या शत्रुता की भावना शामिल हो। यह अक्सर कथित अन्याय, गलत कार्य या हताशा की प्रतिक्रिया में उत्पन्न होता है)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The correct answer is Option 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Anything that is common and easy to get"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Avoiding the main topic, not speaking directly about the issue"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "To force an issue that has already ended"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Stuck between two very bad options"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is "Anything that is common and easy to get."

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \nKey Points       \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The expression "a dime a dozen" is an idiomatic phrase used to convey that something is very common, abundant, or easily found. (कोई चीज़ बहुत सामान्य, प्रचुर या आसानी से पाई जाने वाली है)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • It implies that the item or person in question is not rare or valuable and is, instead, quite commonplace.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: Talented singers are a dime a dozen in this music competition.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t

          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The preposition "for" is used in the blank to correctly indicate the responsibility or accountability associated with the project. 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In this context, "responsible for" is a standard collocation that is commonly used to express ownership or duty regarding a particular task or project.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • To: Used to indicate direction, destination, or purpose.\n\n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: She is going to the store.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The phrase "who have lost" indicates that the action of losing a loved one has occurred in the past and has relevance to the present moment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • This usage effectively communicates the idea that most people who have experienced this loss continue to find the subject unfamiliar.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The correct answer is Option 2.
